WITH locally_funded AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School AS school_name,
        s.DOCType,
        (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS enrollment_diff
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    DOCType
FROM locally_funded
WHERE enrollment_diff > (SELECT AVG(enrollment_diff) FROM locally_funded)
ORDER BY school_name

WITH locally_funded AS (
    SELECT
        s.School AS school_name,
        s.DOCType,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS enrollment_diff
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN schools AS s
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE LOWER(s.FundingType) = 'locally funded'
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
      AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(enrollment_diff) AS avg_enrollment_diff
    FROM locally_funded
)
SELECT
    lf.school_name,
    lf.DOCType
FROM locally_funded AS lf
CROSS JOIN avg_diff AS ad
WHERE lf.enrollment_diff > ad.avg_enrollment_diff
ORDER BY lf.school_name

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        `School Name` AS school_name,
        `Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment,
        `Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS free_meal_count,
        CASE
            WHEN `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
            THEN (`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0) / `Enrollment (K-12)`
        END AS eligible_free_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC, CDSCode
        ) AS rn
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    enrollment,
    free_meal_count,
    eligible_free_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (10, 11)
ORDER BY rn

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT full_name
FROM (
    SELECT TRIM(sch.AdmFName1 || ' ' || sch.AdmLName1) AS full_name, 1 AS ord
    FROM schools sch
    JOIN top_school t ON sch.CDSCode = t.cds
    WHERE sch.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND sch.AdmFName1 <> ''
      AND sch.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL AND sch.AdmLName1 <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT TRIM(sch.AdmFName2 || ' ' || sch.AdmLName2) AS full_name, 2 AS ord
    FROM schools sch
    JOIN top_school t ON sch.CDSCode = t.cds
    WHERE sch.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND sch.AdmFName2 <> ''
      AND sch.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL AND sch.AdmLName2 <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT TRIM(sch.AdmFName3 || ' ' || sch.AdmLName3) AS full_name, 3 AS ord
    FROM schools sch
    JOIN top_school t ON sch.CDSCode = t.cds
    WHERE sch.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND sch.AdmFName3 <> ''
      AND sch.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL AND sch.AdmLName3 <> ''
)
ORDER BY ord

)

    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 AS first_name, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
name_totals AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY first_name
),
top_two_names AS (
    SELECT first_name, total_count
    FROM name_totals
    ORDER BY total_count DESC, first_name
    LIMIT 2
),
name_district_counts AS (
    SELECT a.first_name, a.District, COUNT(*) AS district_count
    FROM admin_names a
    JOIN top_two_names t ON t.first_name = a.first_name
    GROUP BY a.first_name, a.District
)

    t.first_name,
    nd.District,
    t.total_count AS administrator_count,
    nd.district_count
FROM top_two_names t
JOIN name_district_counts nd ON nd.first_name = t.first_name
ORDER BY
    t.total_count DESC,

    nd.district_count DESC,
    nd.District

)

WITH customer_year AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS segment,
         c.CustomerID AS customer_id,
         SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT segment,
         MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_year
  GROUP BY segment
),
avg_lowest AS (
  SELECT cy.segment,
         AVG(cy.annual_consumption) AS avg_annual_consumption
  FROM customer_year cy
  JOIN min_per_segment m
    ON cy.segment = m.segment
   AND cy.annual_consumption = m.min_consumption
  GROUP BY cy.segment
),
seg AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM avg_lowest WHERE segment = 'SME') AS sme,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM avg_lowest WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS lam,
    (SELECT avg_annual_consumption FROM avg_lowest WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS kam
)
SELECT 'SME - LAM' AS comparison, sme - lam AS difference FROM seg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LAM - KAM', lam - kam FROM seg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'KAM - SME', kam - sme FROM seg

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least_customers AS (
    SELECT
        ct.Segment,
        ct.CustomerID,
        ct.total_consumption
    FROM customer_totals AS ct
    JOIN segment_min AS sm
        ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment
       AND sm.min_consumption = ct.total_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM least_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        ((cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cons2013, 0)) AS pct
    FROM seg
)
SELECT 'biggest' AS rank_type, Segment, pct
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, pct
    FROM calc
    WHERE pct IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY pct DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lowest' AS rank_type, Segment, pct
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, pct
    FROM calc
    WHERE pct IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY pct ASC
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0) AS percentage_increase
    FROM segment_consumption
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        percentage_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC) AS rn_high,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC) AS rn_low
    FROM segment_pct
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_high = 1 THEN Segment END) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_high = 1 THEN percentage_increase END) AS biggest_increase_pct,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_low = 1 THEN Segment END) AS lowest_increase_segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_low = 1 THEN percentage_increase END) AS lowest_increase_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_high = 1 OR rn_low = 1

WITH target AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
      AND ABS(Amount * Price - 634.8) < 0.01
    LIMIT 1
),
annual AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM target)
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) * 1.0 / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM annual

WITH target_customer AS (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
    AND Price = 634.8
  LIMIT 1
),
yearly_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM target_customer)
)
SELECT
  (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) * 1.0 / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearly_consumption

WITH customer_spending AS (

        SUM(t.Price) AS total_price,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount,
        c.Currency
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    total_price / total_amount AS average_price_per_item,
    Currency
FROM customer_spending
ORDER BY total_price DESC
LIMIT 1
